title: Artifact graph serialization
description: Durable serialization of the in-memory ArtifactGraph. The same shape mirrors into ChatRunRecord.artifacts[] and WorkflowRunRecord.artifacts[] so cloud and hosted runners can reconstitute the graph on resume. The runtime Map<string, ArtifactNode> serializes as a positional nodes[] array; artifactId uniqueness is a runtime invariant, not expressible cheaply in JSON Schema.

nodes.description: All artifact nodes in the graph. Uniqueness on artifactId is enforced by the runtime, not the schema.

selectedId.description: Optional currently-selected artifact id. When present, MUST match an artifactId in nodes.

compatibilityProjections.description: Read-only legacy projections derived from nodes[]. Populated during the Phase 1-4 transition so existing chat-side code that still reads positional URL arrays keeps working. Deleted after plan Phase 5.
